text:
Ava (CEO): Thanks everyone who joined the all-hands. Leaving this thread open for quick follow-ups about mission, positioning, roadmap clarifications. Drop short Qs and we'll answer through the day.

Meera (Product): Quick q — when we say 'unified inference across environments', do we mean GA feature parity between Hosted and Private, or will parity be staggered?

Rafael (CTO): short answer: parity is our long-term goal but Hosted will continue to lead on experimental features. Private/ Dedicated ship core runtime + API parity first; Console/advanced ops features will follow. We'll publish a parity matrix next week.

Jon (Eng): For Dedicated customers — what's the expected SLA improvement vs Hosted? any rough numbers we can share?

Ava (CEO): Dedicated target is 99.9% monthly uptime for committed pools, with latency SLOs tied to instance class. Expect ~50–100ms p50 for our standard gen configs; we’ll document specifics on the SLO page.

Priya (Growth): GTM question: are we leaning more into PLG or pivoting to field sales for large enterprise deals?

Meera (Product): PLG remains primary. Field sales/team-led engagement kicks in after usage thresholds (e.g., when teams hit ~$X/mo). We’ll also use channel partners for regulated industries.

Kai (Research): Competitor messaging: how should we position cost/perf vs big cloud vendors without getting into a naming fight?

Rafael (CTO): Focus on predictable unit economics, inference controls (batching, caching, quant profiles), and operational guarantees. Use anonymized benchmarks and customer stories — avoid direct head-to-head claims in top-of-funnel collateral.

Jon (Eng): Model policy — will Hosted only include Redwood-verified open models or can community models be listed?

Rafael (CTO): We'll have a curated & verified catalog. Community models can be available under a separate "community" tier with clear warnings; enterprise/verified models will be labelled as such.

Ava (CEO): Sales and docs want a short blurb they can paste into playbooks. Can Product give a 2-paragraph summary + action checklist?

Meera (Product): Yep — I’ll draft a 2-paragraph positioning blurb + parity checklist and drop it here. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Priya (Growth): Any other asks from the group? @Rafael @Meera

Jon (Eng): Can we get a simple matrix showing batching size vs cost impact for Optimize recommendations? Sales asks for concrete ranges.

Rafael (CTO): I’ll add a typical-impact table to Meera’s parity doc. Note: batching impact varies by model & seq length; we’ll provide typical ranges and a short note on variance.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance tonight 23:00 - 23:30 UTC — no downtime expected.

Kai (Research): Last one — for marketing, what concrete reliability metrics do we publish? uptime alone feels thin.

Ava (CEO): Agreed. Publish uptime, failover success rate, and % of requests served by fallback path (graceful degradation). We’ll add example thresholds to the public pages.

Meera (Product): tagging followups: @Ava, @Rafael, @Priya — I’ll post the drafts and matrix here when ready.

Ava (CEO): Thanks all — appreciate the quick q's. We’ll update this thread as items land. :heart:
